actions.title: Strict Monotonicity Gate Enforcement in Multi-Mesh CFD Audits
actions.description: Require R = eps21 / eps32 to be strictly in (0, 1) before declaring monotonic mesh convergence. Correctly classify R < 0 as oscillatory convergence.
actions.verificationMethod: Test TEST-CFD-01 executes GciEngine scalar contract and asserts oscillatory detection.

actions.title: Analytical Benchmark Binding for CFD Poiseuille Flow
actions.description: Bind CFD validation to analytical Navier-Stokes formulas (dp = 12*mu*L*u/H^2) in addition to mass conservation.
actions.verificationMethod: Test TEST-CFD-02 checks exact analytical pressure gradient and velocity ratio.

actions.title: Cryptographic Determinism and Canonical State Invalidation Protocol
actions.description: Enforce that all multidomain co-simulations generate SHA-256 state hashes that automatically invalidate upon model mutation.
actions.verificationMethod: Tests TEST-COUPLE-04 and TEST-DETERMINISM-01 verify hash invalidation and determinism.
